# Effects are rejected before execution; logs use one-way copied-byte writes.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip

go build -gcflags=all=-d=isolateeffects=0 -o effect-test$GOEXE ./host
exec ./effect-test$GOEXE
stdout 'effect matrix passed$'
stdout '^logging passed$'
stdout '^host alive$'

[race] go build -race -o effects-race$GOEXE ./host
[race] exec ./effects-race$GOEXE
[race] stdout 'effect matrix passed$'
[race] stdout '^logging passed$'

# Diagnostic stack capture must remain valid when allocation moves a stack.
[cgo] [race] go build -race -gcflags=runtime=-d=maymorestack=runtime.mayMoreStackMove -o effects-move$GOEXE ./host
[cgo] [race] exec ./effects-move$GOEXE
[cgo] [race] stdout 'effect matrix passed$'
[cgo] [race] stdout '^logging passed$'

! go build -o bad-test$GOEXE ./badhost
stderr 'isolate: forbidden operation os.ReadFile in entry'
! go build -o bad-unsafe-test$GOEXE ./badunsafehost
stderr 'isolate: forbidden unsafe operation in entry'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolateeffects

go 1.26
-- badhost/main.go --
package main
import _ "example.org/isolateeffects/bad"
func main() {}
-- badunsafehost/main.go --
package main
import _ "example.org/isolateeffects/badunsafe"
func main() {}
-- bad/bad.go --
package bad
import "os"
//go:isolate
func Work() { _, _ = os.ReadFile("sentinel") }
-- badunsafe/bad.go --
package badunsafe
import "unsafe"
//go:isolate
func Work() { _ = unsafe.String((*byte)(nil), 0) }
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
import (
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "log"
 "log/slog"
 "strings"
 "example.org/isolateeffects/effects"
)
func init() { fmt.Print("initializer") }

//go:isolate
func Work(mode string) {
 defer func() {
  if recover() != nil { _, _ = isolate.Call(3, nil) }
  _, _ = isolate.Call(2, nil)
 }()
 if mode == "log" {
  n, err := fmt.Printf("value=%d", 7)
  if n != 7 || err != nil { panic("printf count/error") }
  log.SetFlags(0)
  log.Print("standard")
  slog.Info("structured", "count", 7)
  println(strings.Repeat("x", 60000), 42)
  println(strings.Repeat("x", 100000)) // Oversized observations are dropped.
 } else {
  effects.Run(mode)
 }
 _, _ = isolate.Call(4, nil)
}
-- effects/effects.go --
package effects
import (
 "crypto/rand"
 "net"
 "os"
 "reflect"
 "runtime"
 "time"
 "unsafe"
 "weak"
 "isolate"
)
func native()
func unsafeAccess() { p := new(int); _ = *(*int)(unsafe.Pointer(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)))) }
func environ() { _ = os.Getenv("HOME") }
func writeFile() { _ = os.WriteFile("sentinel", []byte("changed"), 0600) }
func alias() { _, _ = isolate.Call(9, nil); bypass() }
//go:linkname bypass runtime.nanotime
func bypass() int64
func Run(mode string) {
 switch mode {
 case "nested": _, _ = isolate.New(isolate.Config{})
 case "environment": environ()
 case "file": writeFile()
 case "network": _, _ = net.Dial("tcp", "127.0.0.1:1")
 case "entropy": _, _ = rand.Read(make([]byte, 1))
 case "gc": runtime.GC()
 case "zone": _, _ = time.LoadLocation("America/Los_Angeles")
 case "weak": _ = weak.Make(new(int))
 case "unsafe": unsafeAccess()
 case "native": native()
 case "reflect-unsafe": reflect.ValueOf(reflect.ValueOf(new(int))).MethodByName("UnsafePointer").Call(nil)
 case "alias": alias()
 case "reflect": reflect.ValueOf(os.Getenv).Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf("HOME")})
 case "go": blocked := make(chan struct{}); go func() { environ(); close(blocked) }(); <-blocked
 case "defer": defer environ()
 }
}
-- effects/native_amd64.s --
#include "textflag.h"
TEXT ·native(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-0
 RET
-- effects/native_arm64.s --
#include "textflag.h"
TEXT ·native(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-0
 RET
-- host/main.go --
package main
import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "os"
 "strings"
 "time"
 "example.org/isolateeffects/jobs"
)
func main() {
 if err := os.WriteFile("sentinel", []byte("host"), 0600); err != nil { panic(err) }
 handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work); if !ok { panic("missing handle") }
 program := handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle) {
  input, err := isolate.Call(1, nil); if err != nil { panic(err) }
  err = h.Invoke(func(v ...isolate.Value) error { *v[0].Pointer.(*string) = string(input); return nil }, func(...isolate.Value) error { return nil })
  if err != nil { panic(err) }
 })
 now := time.Date(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 for _, deterministic := range []bool{false, true} {
  for _, mode := range []string{"nested", "environment", "file", "network", "entropy", "gc", "zone", "weak", "unsafe", "native", "alias", "reflect", "reflect-unsafe", "go", "defer", "log"} {
   var logs []isolate.LogRecord
   i, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program, Deterministic: deterministic, InitialTime: &now, TimerOp: 10, LogHandler: func(r isolate.LogRecord) { logs = append(logs, r) }})
   if err != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("new %s: %v", mode, err)) }
   if len(logs) != 1 || logs[0].Message != "initializer" { panic(fmt.Sprintf("initializer logs: %v", logs)) }
   if err := i.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
   succeeded := false
  running:
   for {
    select {
    case message := <-i.Writes():
     if message.Op != isolate.LogOp { panic("unexpected write operation") }
     r, err := isolate.DecodeLog(message.Payload); if err != nil { panic(err) }
     logs = append(logs, r)
    case c := <-i.Commands():
     switch c.Op {
     case 1: c.Reply([]byte(mode), nil)
     case 4:
      if mode != "log" { panic("effect returned: "+mode) }
      succeeded = true; c.Reply(nil, nil)
     case 2:
      if mode != "log" { panic("application defer ran: "+mode) }
      c.Reply(nil, nil)
     case 8: c.Reply(nil, nil) // child violation may happen after this handshake
     default: panic(fmt.Sprintf("application recovery/alias ran: %s op %d", mode, c.Op))
     }
    case <-i.Done(): break running
    case <-time.After(10*time.Second): panic("timeout: "+mode)
    }
   }
  drainLogs:
   for {
    select {
    case message := <-i.Writes():
     r, err := isolate.DecodeLog(message.Payload); if err != nil { panic(err) }
     logs = append(logs, r)
    default: break drainLogs
    }
   }
   err = i.Wait()
   if mode == "log" {
    if err != nil || !succeeded { panic(fmt.Sprintf("logging: %v", err)) }
    if len(logs) != 5 || logs[1].Source != "fmt" || logs[2].Source != "log" || logs[3].Source != "slog" || logs[4].Source != "builtin" || logs[4].Message != strings.Repeat("x", 60000)+" 42\n" || i.DroppedWrites() != 1 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("logging sources/counts: %d drops: %d", len(logs), i.DroppedWrites())) }
   } else {
    expected := map[string]string{"nested":"isolate.New", "environment":"os.Getenv", "file":"os.WriteFile", "network":"net.Dial", "entropy":"crypto/rand.Read", "gc":"runtime.GC", "zone":"time.LoadLocation", "weak":"weak.Make", "unsafe":"unsafe operation", "native":"effects.native", "alias":"go:linkname runtime.nanotime", "reflect":"os.Getenv", "reflect-unsafe":"reflect.(*Value).UnsafePointer", "go":"os.Getenv", "defer":"os.Getenv"}
    var effect *isolate.EffectError
    if !errors.As(err, &effect) || !strings.Contains(effect.Operation, expected[mode]) || !strings.Contains(effect.Stack, "example.org/isolateeffects/") { panic(fmt.Sprintf("wrong %s fault: %v", mode, err)) }
    if err := i.Resume(); err == nil { panic("faulted instance resumed") }
    if err := i.Start(); err == nil { panic("faulted instance restarted") }
   }
   ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
   err = i.Kill(ctx); cancel(); if err != nil { panic(err) }
   data, err := os.ReadFile("sentinel"); if err != nil || string(data) != "host" { panic("external file changed") }
  }
 }
 fmt.Println("effect matrix passed")
 fmt.Println("logging passed")
 fmt.Println("host alive")
}
